scope: Read-only independent local audit of the PRO5000 high-concurrency stability and SM120 page-mask/page-split E2E +8.61% claims; no network check and no archive modification.

结论/复现必要材料齐全.assessment: Conclusion evidence and reproduction code/configuration/commands/seeds are retained. Strict self-contained replay inputs are not all archived: model assets and the ShareGPT sampling dataset must be obtained separately; the original public dataset hash is not recorded. This does not mean every historical raw profiler trace is retained.
结论/复现必要材料齐全.pro5000_stability: Includes single-node8GPU and two-node16GPU performance/stress evidence, C512/C640/C1024 logs, KV capability / rebootstrap / graceful abort and page-alignment patches/tests. Stability means scheduler/service survival under overload; e.g. random-ID C512 run documents 504 normal completions and 8 graceful aborts, not 512 successful requests.
结论/复现必要材料齐全.sm120_e2e: All 6 non-profiler paired raw benchmark logs, identical seeds 1787127001/2/3, run/summary/paired CSV, benchmark command, summary script, TP0 kernel tables and ON/OFF lightweight Perfetto are present. Split ON mean Output TPS=38.36 vs OFF=35.32, improvement=8.6070%; paired median=4.50%, with only three pairs and substantial variation.
